rawContent: I have never been so embarrassed of the nation of my birth. To have our  President refer to Haiti and African nations as "shithole countries" is  racism and classism at its finest.  America we can  do better. We should do better. We are better than this. #Trump #BlackLivesMatter
Don't just use Blacks when the race to election day is on, create and enact policies that uplift our communities. #MLKDay #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/PF1Vks0scu

Dr. King's dream is far from realized. In an America where poverty is racialized, stereotypes of Black men lead to their deaths, automatic  guilt in every situation and the expansion of the prison industrial  complex--- we have a long way to go. #MLKDay #BlackLivesMatter

Dr. King's dream is far from realized. From food deserts to inequitable education systems that put a higher value on the futures of white children than Blacks, the country of  promise that my people live in is quite different from that of many  others. #MLKDay #BlackLivesMatter
